ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of money in the Minnesota Medicaid system and look for any potential vulnerabilities that could be exploited by fraudsters.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to Medicaid fraud in the state?
ideas.insight: By following the money and analyzing data, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that could help us understand the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and how to prevent it in the future.
